verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's own docs say Payroll AI collects employee time and attendance data so admins can run payroll, and that approved timesheets sync to QuickBooks. That covers the core idea of time data feeding payroll. However, there is no evidence on overtime calculation or hourly-rate handling, and nothing explicitly says approved hours populate the payroll run itself. Missing for 10: documented overtime calculation and rules, explicit evidence that approved hourly entries pre-fill paychecks in the payroll run, independent or hands-on corroboration.
